messages:
maya: fyi we've got a noticeable regression on dashboard loads after last night's canary. heatmap/legend tiles are 2-3x slower, and total bundle for the console route jumped ~380KB. dashboard perf: https://perf.internal/redwood/console (can see spikes)
sam: :eyes: which rollout was that? any new client-side changes? looks like routing-affinity flags landed yesterday
maya: yeah the affinity rollout (route-affinity=v2) + a small splitpoint tweak. timeline matches.
jorge: deploy-bot shows the affinity change + canary at 03:12 UTC
deploy-bot: deploy 2026.03.19-0348 applied to cluster: infra/console-canary, commit: a1b2c3d
maya: network waterfall shows multiple duplicate requests for widget bundles (same chunk id) when users navigate between tabs. suspect chunk is being re-requested due to different route keys being used per-route.
maya: example waterfall snippet:
```
GET /static/chunk-legend.9ab3.js 200 120ms
GET /static/chunk-legend.9ab3.js 200 118ms
GET /static/chunk-legend.9ab3.js 200 121ms
```
maya: it's like the in-memory chunk cache isn't matching because URL signing/route-affinity adds a query param per-request.
sam: ah — routing-affinity tacks on `?node=eu-east-xyz` to proxied asset URLs for debugging sticky routing. that was meant for server logs only, my bad.
anya: if the CDN treats that as cache-busting, we lose edge caching and get cold fetches for every node tag. that'll blow up both latency and bandwidth.
jorge: agreed. temporary mitigation: strip node tag from asset proxy URL and send it in a header instead. simple nginx rewrite will do. also we should add `Cache-Control: immutable, max-age=31536000` for chunked assets so query params don't matter.
sam: patch proposal: remove query param for JS/CSS assets in proxy and set header X-Node-Tag: <tag>. PR coming.
maya: Parallel issue: telemetry sampling rate doubled for console routes (mistaken flag flip), so charts are pulling heavier telemetry payloads. Anya — can you confirm?
anya: yep, telemetry.sample.default went from 0.02 -> 0.04 in the rollout config. That explains extra payloads and some server-side compute. rolling that back to 0.02 will cut load roughly in half.
maya: two-pronged: 1) revert telemetry sample change, 2) stop using query param for assets, 3) add deferred-hydrate for non-visible widgets. thoughts?
sam: +1. I'd also propose a quick canary rollback of route-affinity for Console routes while we validate the header approach. we can keep route-affinity for other APIs.
jorge: I'll open an infra PR to rewrite the proxy and add cache headers. canary patch to rollback affinity on console in parallel. ETA ~45m.
anya: I'll push telemetry rollback now and monitor. will post metrics in 15.
maya: I'll draft a small frontend change to set `deferHydrate: true` for legend/heatmap widgets (only hydrate on intersection). tiny PR: https://repo.internal/redwood/console/pull/1234
maya: action items:
- sam: revert route-affinity for console canary (hotfix) :sam:
- jorge: proxy header + cache-control PR :infra:
- anya: telemetry.sample rollback and monitoring :eyes:
- maya: deferred hydrate PR + canary test plan

sam: I'll coordinate the rollback and update the canary dashboard. will ping #incidents if things go sideways.
maya: thanks everyone. once infra patch lands we should see immediate improvements in bundle request counts. if not, we'll dig deeper into chunk naming/webpack runtime.
jorge: quick nginx snippet I'll run in the patch:
```
# strip node query for assets
if ($request_uri ~* \/static\/.*\?node=) {
  rewrite ^(.*)\?node=.* $1? permanent;
}
proxy_set_header X-Node-Tag $arg_node;
```
maya: awesome. ping me when the canary rollback is live and I'll run a local smoke test.
sam: canary rollback scheduled 1758001500 -> 1758001620, I'll report back.
maya: :rocket:
